key_metric: Underlying (ex-IEEPA-tariff-refund) Q2 operating income vs the $45-50m guide, and whether the FY26 $390-410m operating income guide survives -- it requires $312-337m (80-86% of the year) in H2 at a tariff rate stepping 10% to 15%. Note the 10-Q states the >=$108.3m of CBP CAPE tariff refunds already received will be booked as a reduction of cost of sales in this exact quarter (13 weeks ended 2026-08-01), and that guidance excludes it, so headline GAAP EPS will vastly exceed the $0.21-0.22 consensus for non-operating reasons. Secondary: American Eagle-brand comps (guided flat to negative LSD) vs Aerie (guided high-teens to low-twenties).
